findings.label: README escape-character corruption
findings.detail: In 'Known limitations (Phase 9)', `favicon.ico` became <FF>avicon.ico and `vercel.live` became <VT>ercel.live (PowerShell backtick escapes). Restore both words with their backticks.

findings.label: Blob upload CSP not exercised end to end
findings.detail: Admin connect-src 'self' https://vercel.com rests on reading @vercel/blob/dist only. After the Blob token is set, do one real upload and check the console, or add that to the go-live checklist.
